title: Gibson Deluxe Protector Case, ES-339, Black

long_description.body:
Inspired by the design of vintage 70s-era Gibson “chainsaw” cases, Gibson Deluxe Protector Series hardshell cases feature rugged polyethylene shells and modern improvements like TSA-approved locks, ergonomic soft-grip handles, and black powder-coated hardware. Protect your instrument with a case that delivers both vintage-inspired style and modern technology.





Four heavy-duty latches with a TSA-approved lock on the center latch




Accessory compartment




Blue plush interior lining




Internal dimensions: 41" length, 17.5" body length, 9.75" upper body width, 8” middle body/waist width, 13" lower body width, 1.5" depth




ATA (Air Transport Association) approved
